meta.name: task-decomposition
meta.description: Breaking complex user goals into subtasks that agents can handle.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂目标拆成可执行的子任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将用户模糊需求转化为结构化步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break complex goals into actionable subtasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn vague user requests into structured steps

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会将用户的复杂目标拆解成多个子任务，按顺序、并行或层次等策略执行，并最终合并结果。
howto.when: 当用户提出一个模糊或复杂的、无法由单个代理直接完成的目标时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一次日本旅行，包括机票、酒店、景点和餐饮。
say.note: Claude 会分解为多个子任务并逐步处理。

say.text: 把这个产品方案拆成市场调研、设计、开发和测试四个阶段。
say.note: Claude 会按顺序或并行执行这些子任务。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude breaks down complex user goals into subtasks, executes them sequentially, in parallel, hierarchically, etc., and then reassembles the results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user gives a vague or complex goal that can't be handled by a single agent directly.

say_en.text: Plan a trip to Japan including flights, hotels, attractions, and dining.
say_en.note: Claude will decompose into subtasks and handle them step by step.

say_en.text: Break this product proposal into market research, design, development, and testing phases.
say_en.note: Claude will execute these subtasks sequentially or in parallel.
